fact: Liberia's Deputy Minister for Planning, Research and Development wrote that the World Bank-financed EXCEL project, GPE's system capacity grant, the EU and UNICEF provide targeted support for education data system strengthening, alongside a USD 4.5 million three-year EMIS Action Plan to be funded 60 per cent by the Government of Liberia and 40 per cent by development partners; he also wrote that limited resources prevented consistent data collection between 2022 and 2025.
title: Strengthening EMIS Through Peer Learning: How Liberia is Leading Its Own Data Transformation
